description: Every row of every format, and the rest of the file, that holds any of `terms`: each hit by format, row and column, columns searched as shown. One call where `format_rows`’ `search` is one a format. Or `denylist`, a `--replace-text` file: the scan before a document is shared — hits only, a term named by its line, and the file’s bytes checked for a deleted value. Reads only.

denylist.description: Instead of `terms`: a denylist’s absolute path, `literal==>x` or `regex:pattern==>x` a line.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

terms.description: Words or phrases, any case, up to 50.

name: search_document
title: Search the whole document
